conn.unreachable: Can't reach Her on this machine. Trying again…

error.disconnected: The connection to Her was lost

defaults.note: New assistants start with these; each can change them in its own settings. Full access is turned on for one assistant at a time, in the app, with Touch ID.
defaults.saved: Saved. New assistants start with it.

manual.title: Ask Permissions
manual.desc: Asks before changing files or running commands

accept-edits.title: Accept Edits
accept-edits.desc: Changes files in its folder without asking; asks before commands

bypass-permissions.title: Full Access
bypass-permissions.desc: Runs everything without asking, except deny rules, ask rules and deleting critical paths

instructions.placeholder: For example: Answer in English, briefly. When unsure, ask before acting.
instructions.note: Every assistant of this environment is told this, besides its own instructions.

data.title: This environment's data
data.holds: In it: the assistants and the files they made, conversations, routines, instructions, settings and skills.
data.leaves: Left out: keys and sign-ins, which stay on this machine (model API keys, the ChatGPT and connector sign-ins, the browser's cookies), and caches and logs.

browser.sitesEmpty: No sites yet. Her asks before it opens a site; “Always allow” adds it here.
browser.allSitesDesc: Private network addresses are not included
browser.sitesNote: Sites not listed ask the first time.
browser.addLevel: Permission for the site to add
browser.badSite: Enter a site such as example.com or https://example.com.
